mathematics.assertion_tested: Six symbolic identities for the square-root point-baryon halo; positive Abel-inversion values at seven energies; velocity-integral density reconstruction at three radii; finite-mass normalization identity at 27 points
mathematics.coefficient_domain: exact symbolic real functions and IEEE double quadrature
mathematics.conventions: G=M_b=a0=1, positive radius, Phi increasing outward, E=v^2/2+Phi; rho is mass density
non_claims: No formation dynamics, stability, finite-mass halo completion, extended baryons, cosmological validation, or scale selection
